blocks.tamil_translation: this man, Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA), has just now said, and gone, that the Prophet ﷺ said this' ”.

blocks.text: Carrying out the commands of Allah Ta'ala with the thought that Allah Ta'ala is in front of me and is watching me

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ لا وَهُدًي وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۞ قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا ؕ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O mankind, there has certainly come to you good counsel from your Rabb and a perfect cure for what is in (your) breasts, and (it is) guidance and mercy for the believers (in the One God). (O Prophet,) say: “(This, the Qur'an,) has come through the grace of Allah and His mercy; so let them rejoice in it. It is far better than the (worldly wealth) they gather”.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِنْ رَّبِكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهُدًي وَّبُشْرَي لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say, “From your Rabb - to make the believers firm, and as guidance and glad tidings for those who submit completely (the Muslims) - with the truth, this was sent down by “Ruh-ul-Qudus'
